verses.gurmukhi: ਦੈਤ ਸੁਤ ਭਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਭਏ ਦੇਵ ਸੁਤ ਜਗ ਮੈ ਸਨੀਚਰ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhait sut bhagat pragaT prahilaadh bhe dhev sut jag mai saneechar bakhaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Bhagat Prehlad who made everyone in the city meditate on the name of the Lord, took birth in the house of evil-minded Harnakash. But Sanichar (Saturn) the son of Sun is believed to be an inauspicious and distressing constellation in the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਧੁ ਪੁਰ ਬਾਸੀ ਕੰਸ ਅਧਮ ਅਸੁਰ ਭਏ ਲੰਕਾ ਬਾਸੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਭੀਖਨ ਪਛਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: madh pur baasee ka(n)s adham asur bhe la(n)kaa baasee sevak bhabheekhan pachhaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Of the six sacred cities, one is Mathura which was ruled by a vice-ridden demon-like king called Kansa. Also, Bhabhikhan a God-loving devotee was born in Lanka, the infamous city of Ravan.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਈ ਅਹਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਨਿ ਉਦੈ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: saagar ga(n)bheer bikhai bikhiaa pragaas bhiee eh masatak man udhai unamaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: The deep ocean yielded the death-giving poison. It is also believed that the most poisonous snake has an invaluable jewel in its head.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਰਨ ਸਥਾਨ ਲਘੁ ਦੀਰਘ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਬਿਸਮ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੪੦੭॥
verses.translit_en: baran sathaan lagh dheeragh jatan karai akath kathaa binodh bisam na jaaneeaai ||407||

en.bdb: So, considering someone high or low, good or bad because of the place of his birth or family lineage is just a misconception. This is an indescribable and wondrous play of the Lord that no one can know.   (407)
